notes.title: Astrodelia, Indie Games Awards
notes.content:
Hello everyone, back from summer, good news: Astrodelia has been selected for the 2024 Malaga Indie Games Awards (Spain)!!!!
Results in mid-October…let's see if we get lucky!!
https://bit.ly/Astrodelia
https://bit.ly/AstrodeliaOnSteam

notes.title: Astrodelia Selection
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Astrodelia has been selected at the Busan Indie Connect Festival 2024!!!!
It is in the General Division section. The bad thing is that I won't be able to attend the event in person.

notes.title: Astrodelia Launch
notes.content:
Astrodelia is now available!!
To beat the summer heat there is nothing like a SciFi adventure in cold space.
